timeline: If you stand inside the 2,300-Year-Old Echo Caves of Barabar, polished granite strongly echoes your voice. Who built them?
In third century BC, Emperor Ashoka acted.
Workers carved massive granite hills in Bihar.
They created mirror-polished walls with unbelievable precision.
Monks of the ancient Ajivika sect entered.
Then, work abruptly stopped at Lomas Rishi.
Work was abandoned, leaving unchipped rock pikes on the floor.
A sudden mystery froze time inside.
Part 2 is already on my channel.
